title: Loyalty Credit Terms on Trade-In Shortfall Payments
content:
**Terms.** A customer trading in a vehicle that Kestrel sold to them receives a loyalty credit against a payoff shortfall under **Trade-In Agreements**. Whether Kestrel sold the vehicle is read from the customer's records under **Vehicle Purchase Agreements**: a completed Kestrel purchase order on the traded vehicle's VIN. The size of the credit depends on autopay on the contract under **Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts** of the purchase the trade is applied to.

| Completed Kestrel purchase order on the traded VIN | Autopay on the Kestrel Auto Finance contract of the purchase the trade is applied to | Loyalty credit |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Enrolled | $60.00 |
| Yes | Not enrolled | $30.00 |
| Yes | No such contract | $30.00 |
| No | Any | None |

The loyalty credit is subtracted in figuring the shortfall payment; the payment never falls below none and is rounded to the nearest cent only once, at the end.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A customer bought the traded car from Kestrel (order completed) and is buying a new one through Kestrel Auto Finance with autopay enrolled: credit $60.00.
- The same customer paying cash for the new purchase: $30.00.
- A customer whose traded car came from another dealer: no loyalty credit.
- A shortfall of $25.00 before a $30.00 credit leaves a payment of $0.00, never a negative figure.
